title: The past-ruling guard reads a newer owner ruling before it refuses a question
why: Possible false alarm, from Degen (via the coordinator 20:30 CST Nov 9). The past-ruling guard refused a valid owner question (Degen item 179, cloud push vs box-served install), citing decision ios-mac-install-first. But the owner had ruled at 19:35 CST that the outcome matters, not the route, wanted the question asked, and picked the cloud push at 19:50 CST.
note: Fix: the judge reads rulings newer than the cited decision (chat or page) before it refuses. Related: judge-ids-via-constants, judge-timeout-retries-once. Filed 20:27 CST Nov 9. Lane session_013NEJL2DeoKFVg6TCE2pT2F (coordinator 20:36-20:41 CST Nov 9). Related: #2485 (branch ios-install-box-first-scope, in batch-70c) narrows the cited decision ios-mac-install-first to an app with a box-served install.
